column5: RFC 9110 9.3.6: CONNECT with an empty or invalid port is rejected (CONNECT gets 501)

column4: RFC 9110 10.2.1・15.5.6: 405にはAllowを付ける
column5: RFC 9110 10.2.1, 15.5.6: 405 carries Allow

column4: RFC 9110 13.1.1: If-Matchは強い比較で評価し、偽なら412
column5: RFC 9110 13.1.1: If-Match uses the strong comparison and a false result gets 412

column4: RFC 9110 13.1.2: If-None-Matchは弱い比較で評価し、GET / HEADなら304
column5: RFC 9110 13.1.2: If-None-Match uses the weak comparison and GET / HEAD get 304

column4: RFC 9110 13.1.3: If-None-MatchがあればIf-Modified-Sinceを無視する
column5: RFC 9110 13.1.3: If-Modified-Since is ignored when If-None-Match is present

column4: RFC 9110 13.1.4: If-Unmodified-Sinceが偽なら412
column5: RFC 9110 13.1.4: a false If-Unmodified-Since gets 412

column4: RFC 9112 2.2・5.2・RFC 9110 2.2: アプリがResponseに入れた値のうち、Coded.encoding・任意ヘッダの値・statusが文法の外ならpanic(BadHeader)にし、裸のCR・obs-fold・ABNFの外の頭を送らない
column5: RFC 9112 2.2, 5.2, RFC 9110 2.2: of the values an application puts in a Response, Coded.encoding, custom header values and status that do not match the grammar are a panic(BadHeader), so no bare CR, obs-fold or header outside the ABNF is sent

column4: RFC 9110 5.3: リストでない欄の行を2行生成しない（1行だけの欄の表〔下の節〕にある欄の2本目と、ライブラリが書く欄を任意ヘッダに書くことはpanic(BadHeader)。リストの欄とアプリが定めた欄は2行書ける）
column5: RFC 9110 5.3: no two field lines are generated for a field that is not a list (a second line of a field in the single-line table below, or a field the library writes given as a custom header, is a panic(BadHeader); list fields and fields the application defines may have two lines)

column4: RFC 9110 5.6.4: multipartのboundaryのquoted-stringで、quoted-pairを後ろのオクテットに置き換える
column5: RFC 9110 5.6.4: in a multipart boundary quoted-string, a quoted-pair is replaced by the octet that follows

column4: RFC 9110 5.6.7: RFC 850の2桁の年は、50年より先に見えるなら下2桁が同じ直近の過去の年と読む（今の年から決める）
column5: RFC 9110 5.6.7: a two-digit RFC 850 year that appears more than 50 years in the future is read as the most recent past year with the same last two digits (decided from the current year)

column4: RFC 9110 8.8.2.1: StaticはDateより後のLast-Modifiedを送らない（未来の更新時刻は今の秒に置き換える）
column5: RFC 9110 8.8.2.1: Static never sends a Last-Modified later than Date (a future modification time is replaced by the current second)

column4: RFC 9110 10.1.1: Expect: 100-continueのHTTP/1.1のリクエストには、本文を待つ前に100か最終のstatus（本文が上限を越えるなら413）を送る
column5: RFC 9110 10.1.1: for an HTTP/1.1 request with Expect: 100-continue, a 100 or a final status (413 when the body exceeds the limit) is sent before waiting for the body

column4: RFC 9110 15.2: 1xxを最終のレスポンスにしない（panic(BadHeader)）ので、HTTP/1.0のクライアントに1xxを送らない。HTTP/1.0のExpectは無視する
column5: RFC 9110 15.2: a 1xx is never the final response (panic(BadHeader)), so no 1xx goes to an HTTP/1.0 client; Expect in HTTP/1.0 is ignored

column4: RFC 9110 15.3.6: 205に内容を生成しない（204・205・304に本文があればpanic(BadHeader)。205はContent-Length: 0）
column5: RFC 9110 15.3.6: no content is generated for 205 (a body on 204, 205 or 304 is a panic(BadHeader); 205 carries Content-Length: 0)

column4: RFC 9110 15.4.5: Staticの304に、同じリクエストの200と同じVary: Accept-Encodingを付ける
column5: RFC 9110 15.4.5: a Static 304 carries the same Vary: Accept-Encoding as the 200 for the same request

column4: RFC 9110 2.3: 自分が生成する長さ以上の要素を読める。ライブラリが生成する要素（ETag・HTTP-date）は受けて読める。アプリが長さを決める要素（Set-Cookieの値など）は、返ってきたときに頭の上限（既定8 KiB）に収まる保証が無い
column5: RFC 9110 2.3: elements at least as long as those generated can be parsed. Elements the library generates (ETag, HTTP-date) are parsed when received; elements whose length the application decides (such as Set-Cookie values) are not guaranteed to fit the header limit (8 KiB by default) when they come back

column4: RFC 9112 2.2・5.2・RFC 9110 2.2: ResponseのcontentTypeがmedia-typeの文法の外でも、そのまま送る（検査しない）。名前つきの文字列の型が言語に入った時点で、contentTypeをその型にして、リテラルの文法をコンパイル時に検査する予定。実行時に毎回検査する形は、要求1件あたりの命令が大きく増えるので採らない
column5: RFC 9112 2.2, 5.2, RFC 9110 2.2: a Response contentType outside the media-type grammar is sent as is (not checked). Once named string types are in the language, contentType becomes such a type and its literals are checked against the grammar at compile time. A check on every response at run time is not used, because it adds many instructions per request

column4: RFC 9112 9.8: TLSで閉じる前にclosure alertの交換を始める。std/tlsはkが返れば（errorでも）close_notifyを送るが、kが死んだとき（panic）は送らずに閉じる
column5: RFC 9112 9.8: over TLS, an exchange of closure alerts is initiated before closing. std/tls sends close_notify when k returns (even with an error) but closes without it when k dies (panic)

column4: RFC 9112 6.1・RFC 9110 8.6・9.3.6: CONNECTへの2xxの頭の規則（CONNECTを実装しない）
column5: RFC 9112 6.1, RFC 9110 8.6, 9.3.6: header rules for 2xx responses to CONNECT (CONNECT is not implemented)

column4: RFC 9110 4.2.4: httpとhttpsのURIにuserinfoを生成しない（URIを生成しない）
column5: RFC 9110 4.2.4: no userinfo in generated http and https URIs (the server generates no URIs)

column4: RFC 9110 7.4: httpsのリソースへの安全でない接続のリクエストを拒否する（サーバーはschemeでリソースを分けない）
column5: RFC 9110 7.4: rejecting requests for https resources over insecure connections (the server does not split resources by scheme)

column4: RFC 9110 7.8・15.5.22: 101と426のUpgradeの規則（Upgradeを実装しない）
column5: RFC 9110 7.8, 15.5.22: Upgrade rules for 101 and 426 (Upgrade is not implemented)

column4: RFC 9110 9.3.4: PUTの成否と検証子の規則（PUTの処理はアプリの側）
column5: RFC 9110 9.3.4: PUT outcome and validator rules (PUT handling belongs to the application)

column4: RFC 9110 10.1.1: 100を送ったら最終のstatusを送る
column5: RFC 9110 10.1.1: a final status follows a 100

column4: RFC 9110 11.6.1・15.5.2: 401のWWW-Authenticate（認証はアプリの側）
column5: RFC 9110 11.6.1, 15.5.2: WWW-Authenticate on 401 (authentication belongs to the application)

column4: RFC 9110 12.5.3: 415のAccept-Encoding（415を送らない）
column5: RFC 9110 12.5.3: Accept-Encoding on 415 (415 is never sent)

column4: RFC 9110 15.3.7: 206の頭と内容の規則（Rangeを実装しない）
column5: RFC 9110 15.3.7: header and content rules for 206 (Range is not implemented)
